rounds.rationale: Left wipes/rule and right staged geometry + vermillion nodes comply. The spectrogram fails its core spec: heavy 13-col time-smooth plus low contrast collapses formants into smeared horizontal streaks with no readable bell onset. Fixing grid density, smoothing and floor makes it read as a real voice spectrogram.

defects: bottom strip still low-contrast smeared mush: freq-smoothing merged the harmonic ladder and 4-col time-smooth blurred the bell onset
vertical grid too coarse (240 rows) to resolve distinct formant bands in the 160px strip
vermillion dot + centre-dot used a sine-modulated alpha = fade-like pulse, violating construction-only motion law

edits.old: ROWS, FMIN, FMAX = 240, 80.0, 4200.0   # voice/formant band, finer grid, keep HF harmonics
edits.new: ROWS, FMIN, FMAX = 360, 70.0, 4600.0   # denser vertical grid -> resolved formant ladder + HF harmonics

edits.old:
v = np.clip((v - 0.20) / 0.80, 0, 1) ** 0.82   # deeper floor: crisp ink ridges, no white voids
    _ma = lambda arr, k: np.apply_along_axis(lambda m: np.convolve(m, np.ones(k) / k, mode='same'), 0, arr)
    v = _ma(v, 4)             # time-smooth: narrow window keeps formant ridges + bell transient sharp
    v = _ma(v.T, 2).T         # light freq-smooth: band continuity without merging harmonics
    v = np.clip(v * 1.95, 0, 1)                 # ridge brightness: strong ink bands, no black saturation
edits.new:
v = np.clip((v - 0.25) / 0.75, 0, 1) ** 0.70   # steeper floor+gamma: high-contrast ink ridges
    _ma = lambda arr, k: np.apply_along_axis(lambda m: np.convolve(m, np.ones(k) / k, mode='same'), 0, arr)
    v = _ma(v, 2)             # minimal time-smooth: keeps bell transient a sharp vertical spike
    v = np.clip(v * 2.25, 0, 1)                 # ridge brightness: crisp harmonic/formant ladder

Fixed the two real failures: re-tuned the spectrogram (steeper floor/gamma, dropped freq-smooth, halved time-smooth, denser row grid) so it reads as a crisp formant ladder with a sharp bell spike, and removed the breathing-alpha pulses so nodes grow by radius only.
